name: How do you manage safety and cleanliness during a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do you manage safety and cleanliness during a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good projects use dust barriers, floor protection, regular site cleanup, and clear access routes, along with safety protocols that protect both workers and occupants.
